headline: Turn attention into action
subheadline: A campaign prebuild that puts the cause, the proof, and the next step in clear view.
description: Violet is designed to move people from interest to involvement. Bold calls to action lead the way, while impact highlights and human stories give the campaign room to make its case. Donation moments sit alongside clear paths to volunteer, share, and join in—so participation feels like part of the story, not an afterthought.
card_blurb: Bold campaign pages pair impact proof and human stories with clear ways to give, share, volunteer, and join in.
seo_description: Explore a campaign website prebuild built around bold calls to action, impact proof, human stories, donation moments, and clear ways to take part.
image_notes: Use documentary-style portraits that feel candid, warm, and respectful.
Show people participating in community settings rather than posed corporate scenes.
Pair impact figures with simple visual cues and enough space for the evidence to breathe.
Choose energetic campaign imagery with a violet-led palette and strong contrast for calls to action.
